description: Validated Security Gate snapshots of the PyGoat remediation journey (blocking findings per control).

provenance.source: Security Gate results of the GitLab pipelines run on each commit below, validated manually from the pipeline outputs, screenshots and job logs during the project.
provenance.counts: Number of BLOCKING findings per control, as decided by ci/security_gate.py with the unchanged policy ci/security-policy.toml. Warnings and info findings are not part of these snapshots.
provenance.timestamps: Commit timestamps from git (committer date, converted to UTC). They date the code that was scanned, not the pipeline run.
provenance.pipeline_id: null: the pipeline identifiers of these historical runs are not recorded in a verifiable way, so they are not invented.
provenance.not_a_security_score: A lower number of blockers means fewer findings above the policy thresholds. It is not a percentage of 'how secure' the application is.

snapshots.title: Phase A: base image, non-root container, dependencies
Phase A.1: runtime packaging tools removed from the image
Final secure baseline: application findings remediated, first full PASS
